content.short: Catizen is a popular cat-themed "Tap-to-Earn" game on TON and Mantle, merging idle gameplay with AI-enhanced features.
content.description:
Catizen is a prominent Telegram-based "Play-to-Airdrop" game that has captivated millions of players. Set in a virtual cat cafe, players engage in idle gameplay by breeding and merging cats to increase their levels and earn vKitty, the in-game currency. Operating on both The Open Network (TON) and Mantle Network, Catizen offers a seamless experience where users can interact with the game's economy using wallets from either ecosystem.

The project differentiates itself by integrating AI to enhance virtual pet interactions and ecosystem growth. Beyond merging cats, it features mini-games like fishing and "Kitty Clubs" for social engagement. The CATI token powers the platform, enabling staking and premium purchases, successfully bridging social gaming with decentralized finance.
content.meta: Play and earn with Catizen, the cat-themed idle game on TON and Mantle. Join the feline fun on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
